verdict.rationale: MoonPay's enterprise marketing says the API can accept bank transfers and automatically convert incoming fiat into stablecoins (moonpay-docs-68), and mentions minting and redemption for issued stablecoins (moonpay-docs-69). That is a thin, first-party glimpse of fiat-to-stablecoin balance movement for a business. The rest of the developer evidence covers end-user on-ramp and off-ramp flows, not treasury balances. Missing for 10: documented platform-held fiat and stablecoin balances, internal transfer and rebalancing API endpoints, dashboard treasury controls, end-to-end developer docs for conversion in both directions, and independent corroboration.
